title: Editor E0 task 12b, row ops slice: a node document gets add, remove, move, columns, ratio, title, header and margin row operations
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19. lib/entity-blocks/node-row-ops.ts performs the row-level mutations rows-ops.ts performs on a BuilderLayout, on a NodeLayout: addNodeRow, removeNodeRow (nodes go to the stored bench with their bags), moveNodeRow, setNodeRowColumns (narrowing folds onto the last kept column), setNodeRowRatio, setNodeRowTitle, setNodeRowHeaderOn, setNodeRowMargin. Pure, immutable, total, each result re-normalized. Dormant: no component calls it yet. The node page builder is the consumer.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/entity-blocks/node-row-ops.ts','utf8');const bad=[];for(const f of ['addNodeRow','removeNodeRow','moveNodeRow','setNodeRowColumns','setNodeRowRatio','setNodeRowTitle','setNodeRowHeaderOn','setNodeRowMargin'])if(!s.includes('export function '+f))bad.push('missing '+f);if(!s.includes('normalizeNodeLayout'))bad.push('results are not re-normalized');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1008: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a row op is dropped or results stop going through normalizeNodeLayout. Behavior is node-row-ops.test.ts.
